user.title: Connect to amprex
user.description: In the amprex Web UI, open Settings → Home Assistant and create a connection. Paste the pairing code shown there.

data_description.pairing_code: Shown once when the connection is created or rotated.
data_description.address: IP address of the controller, if its amprex-….local name does not resolve from Home Assistant. The certificate is still checked against the .local name.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair amprex
reauth_confirm.description: amprex refused the stored credential. Rotate the connection in the amprex Web UI and paste the new pairing code.

error.invalid_pairing_code: This is not a valid amprex pairing code.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the controller.
error.invalid_auth: The controller refused the credential. Create or rotate the connection again.
error.tls_error: The controller's certificate does not match the pairing code.
error.no_manifest: Connected, but the controller published no entity list. Check that the integrations service is running.
error.unsupported_manifest: The controller uses a newer format. Update this integration.
error.wrong_controller: This pairing code is for a different controller.

hvac_mode_not_supported.message: Switch comfort control on or off in the amprex Web UI.
